import Grants.Spec
namespace Grants

def otherAdminb (s : State) (u : UserId) : Bool :=
  s.users.any (fun v => decide (v ≠ u) && s.has v .admin)

def validb (s : State) (r : Request) : Bool :=

  (match r.op with
   | .grant => decide (r.actor ≠ r.target) && !(s.has r.target r.role)
   | .revoke => s.has r.target r.role && (decide (r.role ≠ .admin) || otherAdminb s r.target))

def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if validb s r then
    (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => expectedHas s r u q })
  else
    (.rejected, s)

theorem req_valid_succeeds  : ValidSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_invalid_noop    : InvalidNoop step := sorry
theorem req_authorization   : AdminOnly step := sorry
theorem req_no_self_grant   : NoSelfGrant step := sorry
theorem req_others_unchanged : OthersUnchanged step := sorry
theorem req_effects         : Effects step := sorry
theorem req_idempotency     : Idempotent step := sorry
theorem req_last_admin      : KeepsAdmin step := sorry

end Grants
